text:
NJ Motor Vehicle Mobile Unit to visit Middletown Oct. 28 
 • EASTERN MONMOUTH COUNTY EDITION • 
 ​ 
 ​ 
 ​ 
 ​ 
 NJ Motor Vehicle Mobile Unit to visit Middletown Oct. 28
 October 18, 2026 
MIDDLETOWN — The New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission’s (NJMVC) Mobile Unit will visit Middletown Wednesday, Oct. 28, offering residents an opportunity to take care of a variety of motor vehicle services without having to travel to a traditional MVC agency.
(This story is continued under the ad)
 The NJMVC Agency-on-Wheels will be stationed at the Middletown Municipal Building, located at 1 Kings Highway, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Appointments are required, and residents are encouraged to reserve a spot in advance. 
The mobile unit will offer a range of services, including New Jersey driver licenses and non-driver identification cards, including REAL ID, as well as new applications and renewals. Other available services include registration renewals, license plate returns, issuance of handicap placards, and boat renewals and stickers.
 Residents will also be able to apply for initial permits, upgrade probationary licenses, obtain veteran designations for licenses or non-driver identification cards, and request REAL ID and non-driver identification cards. 
Duplicate and replacement titles will also be available.
The visit is being coordinated through the office of Assemblywoman Vicky Flynn, who represents Legislative District 13.
Because appointments are required, residents should reserve their spots before arriving. 
The mobile service is intended to make commonly needed MVC services more accessible and convenient for Middletown-area residents.
